space: robot space, cm: X forward, Y left, Z up, right-handed; positive rotation about +Y swings a hanging limb backward and leans a torso forward; rest rotation of every part is identity

telegraph.behaviour: clamped, shader shows the last frame (row 30, fists raised) from 0.467 s on; raise over frames 0..13 (0.45 s), held after

strike.behaviour: LOOPED by the shader with RunRate (1.0 on the heavy: 30 fps, wraps after 0.533 s): play it only for the last 0.15 s of the telegraph, frame 4 = contact, frames 4..15 hold the contact pose

recover.behaviour: clamped, last frame (row 61) = rest pose exactly (RestClipId 3 holds it); contact pose held frames 0..2, back to rest by frame 14 (0.467 s)

formula.text: for a part with rest-pose world pivot p, current world rotation R (relative to rest, includes the whole parent chain) and current world pivot position q: new_position = R (v - p) + q = R v + t, with t = q - R p; v = rest vertex in the mesh space of the combined static mesh (the same space as the rest parts FBX, cm).
formula.composition_order: world matrix of a part = parent world matrix @ Translation(rest local offset + keyed local translation) @ Rz Ry Rx (keyed Euler XYZ, about the part pivot). R = world matrix 3x3, q = world matrix translation. The pose is evaluated with Blender object matrix_world (hierarchy), the quaternion is taken from R, t = q - R p is computed from them. In the material: rotate v by the quaternion (x y z w, unit length) then add t.
formula.quaternion_layout: texel x = 2*part_index: RGBA = (qx, qy, qz, qw); texel x = 2*part_index+1: RGB = t in cm, A = 0
formula.sign_continuity: per part, the sign of q is flipped when needed so that dot(q[f], q[f-1]) >= 0 inside each clip; frame 0 and frame 16 start with w >= 0; min dot between run frame 15 and frame 0 = 0.99643

texture.format: OpenEXR RGBA half float (16 bit), compression NONE, colourspace Non-Color (raw linear data), written by Blender save_render
texture.row_mapping: frame f is the f-th scanline of the file counted from the TOP of the image (Unreal row 0 = frame 0 = run start); Blender in-memory row = (height - 1 - f); sample at u = (x + 0.5)/20, v = (f + 0.5)/31

bake_verification.method: for every frame and part: R(q_baked) * v_rest + t_baked against matrix_world @ local vertex of the keyed objects; max over all vertices (cm). float32 = arrays before the EXR; from_saved_exr = values re-read from the half float file (half float step: plain rounding of q and t costs up to ~0.06 cm; the script therefore stores, per frame and part, the float16 q (within one half step of exact) and float16 t (least squares) with the smallest max error, taking the worse of the normalised and not-renormalised quaternion use)

run_loop_closure.note: the next loop's first frame is the pose at phase 16/16; the texture has no frame for it

parameters.pelvis_z_rule: planted walk: pelvis dz solved from the stance foot (robot_walk_planted.py), no ground fit

attack_keys.interpolation: smoothstep per phase; wind-up frames 16..18 reach WIND at frame 18; strike 19..22 reaches STRIKE at frame 22; recovery 23..30 reaches rest at frame 30

slide.note: slide of the lowest foot vertex (same vertex tracked to the next frame, loop wraps) = body-space x change per frame + travel per frame; 0 = planted on the floor. Counted only when the vertex is within 0.5 cm of the floor at the frame and within 1 cm at the next

contact_sheets.camera: orthographic 150 cm frame, 420 px per panel, 8 panels in a row; side = camera at -Y looking +Y (robot faces image right), front = camera at +X; lit rig of meshy_texture_fix.py (EEVEE, sun 4.5, world grey 0.62 strength 0.55), chaser_meshy_fixed_basecolor.png, dark floor slab top at z = 0

warnings: a bake / loop error is above 0.05 cm (see bake_verification)

slam.note: clip 1 = telegraph rows 16..30 (clamped), clip 2 = strike rows 31..46 (looped by the shader: played only for 0.15 s), clip 3 = recover rows 47..61 (clamped, last row = rest)

telegraph.behaviour: clamped, shader shows the last frame (row 30, fists raised) from 0.467 s on; raise over frames 0..13 (0.45 s), held after

strike.behaviour: LOOPED by the shader with RunRate (1.0 on the heavy: 30 fps, wraps after 0.533 s): play it only for the last 0.15 s of the telegraph, frame 4 = contact, frames 4..15 hold the contact pose

recover.behaviour: clamped, last frame (row 61) = rest pose exactly (RestClipId 3 holds it); contact pose held frames 0..2, back to rest by frame 14 (0.467 s)

walk_checks.source: positions rebuilt from the SAVED half-float texture (quaternion renormalised as in the shader), rest vertices of the foot parts

foot_slide.rule: per foot and frame pair: the foot vertex that is within 0.6 cm of the floor in both frames (tracked to the next frame, loop wraps); drift = world x change + speed x frame time; the cycle value is the sum of |drift| over both feet. Pairs with no such vertex (the heel to toe switch of the rolling foot) are not counted
